reference: Asp, L.E., & Brandt, F. (1997). Effects of pores and voids on the interlaminar delamination toughness of a carbon/epoxy composite. Proceedings of the 11th International Conference on Composite Materials (ICCM-11), Gold Coast, Australia, Vol. II, pp. 322-331.
data_source: Table 1 (tabulated): G_C at crack growth initiation and the maximum G_C during propagation of the void-free and voided laminates, DCB (mode I) and ENF (mode II); open-access PDF on Zenodo (record 15409117, CC-BY-SA-4.0)
porosity_measurement: image analysis (OPTILAB) of 36 cross-sections over 20 specimens: 0.9 % in the laminate, 1.4 % at the 0/+5 interface of the starter crack and 9.2 % at the +5/-5 interface; the void-free laminate is that of the authors' earlier report (ref. 7 of the paper), whose void content is not quantified here

G_Ic.test_standard: DCB, corrected beam theory with Olsson's correction (no standard named)

G_IIc.test_standard: ENF, Carlsson and Gillespie (no standard named)

notes: HTA/6376C prepreg cured at 175 C and 6 bar; the voided laminate was made by turning the vacuum pump off after evacuation and venting the bag to 1 atm during cure. Specimens 20 x 150 mm, 3.3 mm thick (3.1 mm void-free), with a 35 mm, 7.5 um Upilex 7.5S polyimide film insert, pre-loaded to release the film; dried 2 weeks at 70 C; 7 specimens per test. Voids are needle shaped along the fibres and irregularly distributed (one specimen reached 2.2 % in the laminate and 25.8 % at an interface). The void contents here are the laminate values; at the starter-crack interface the voids are 1.4 %. Mode I (Table 1, J/m2, +- standard deviation): initiation 229.0 (17.8) void-free and 239.8 (9.7) voided, unchanged; maximum during propagation 253.4 (6.6) and 441.4 (50.8): the voided specimens show a strong R-curve from ply splits bridging the crack (bridged zone 25-30 mm), absent without voids. Mode II: crack growth was unstable, so initiation equals the maximum, 883.1 (117.5) and 811.3 (57.0), -8 %; four voided specimens precracked in mode I confirmed the insert value (not tabulated). Mixed mode (MMB, G_II/G about 0.54, not a schema key): initiation 478.8 (43.7) and 381.4 (47.6), -20 %; maximum 487.1 (45.5) and 454.5 (70.3). The flexural modulus of the voided laminate was 7.5 % lower (111 GPa). The authors conclude the voids do not impair the static delamination toughness of this material; the Mehdikhani et al. 2019 review lists the mode II initiation as an increase, against Table 1.
